title: Scale-Aware Self-Supervised Learning for Segmentation of Small and Sparse Structures
mechanism: Add small-window cropping to the SSL augmentation pipeline so the pretext task zooms on fine sparse structures; gains appear only for small targets.
adaptation: Redo pool SSL (DINO / SimCLR style on ResNet-34 and ConvNeXt-T) with 32-96 px windows upsampled, half sampled near dark ridges (black-top-hat / Frangi response), half uniform; then house and PF fine-tune.
min_experiment: Arm scale-aware SSL init + PF vs PF and vs the existing MIM checkpoint, 5 seeds; metrics test crack IoU and crack components >= 20 px found; kill if crack IoU gain < +0.012.
evidence: R: up to +13% on seismic fault (thin line) segmentation and +5% on cell delineation under label limits; little benefit on large regions.
prior_overlap: MIM/DDeP on 11.9k pool n.d. used standard crops; a thin-structure-aware SSL objective is listed as open.
